summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @ornikar/prismic-components@0.0.2 declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, chmod +x's it, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB '@bun-cjs' compiled bundle with a shuffled string-array indirection layer (rotator function WV8StW over a large hex/character-fragment table n7gIxM) and hex-mangled identifiers, hiding all string literals including URLs, filesystem paths, and API calls. Execution occurs automatically on npm install before any user code runs. The package ships under a name suggesting a Prismic CMS component library for the @ornikar scope but has no README, empty description/author fields, and no source that corresponds to that advertised purpose — the only install-time effect is fetching an alternate language runtime and using it to execute an opaque bundle whose behavior the installer cannot inspect. This is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: pulling a second runtime specifically to execute code that Node-based tooling and scanners cannot easily trace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
